proofs.sbml_choice: clean_model sbml_text (chosen). Production json_to_sbml.build_sbml runs offline (no DB code; mysql_connected is always false) and parses clean, but loses content on stored payloads (evidence/V6/sbml_compare_10.json, 10 payloads, species/reactions/compartments): idx 3 clean 11/6/7 vs prod 12/6/11; idx 14 5/1/2 vs 6/1/2; idx 29 19/6/4 vs 19/6/5; idx 50 20/6/4 vs 19/6/5; idx 70 12/3/6 vs 13/3/5; idx 88 10/1/4 vs 11/1/2; idx 109 9/1/2 vs 9/1/3; idx 123 7/2/2 vs 8/2/2; idx 133 13/5/2 vs 14/4/2; idx 143 9/3/1 vs 10/3/2. Difference classes, from a species/reaction listing of idx 14, 88, 133, 3 (scratch sbml_diff.py): (1) prod adds a placeholder species named 'Unknown' in compartment c_cell whenever an enzyme-catalysed reaction needs a modifier slot (+1 species on 6 of 10 payloads); not paper content. (2) prod puts enzymes, complexes and unscoped proteins in the default 'cell' compartment (idx 14 HMGR, idx 88 ALAS2 complex, idx 133 the three complexes); clean keeps them in the reaction's own compartment. (3) prod renames every reaction to an 'A + B -> C' equation and drops the paper's reaction name; clean keeps the names. (4) prod splits a location into several compartments with numeric suffixes (idx 3: apical membrane x3, cytoplasm x2, synaptic vesicles x2, 11 vs 7) and omits parent compartments (idx 88: no cytoplasm or mitochondrion); clean emits one compartment per location with its parents. (5) REACTION LOSS: idx 133 prod emits 4 reactions for 5 payload reactions (HldE bifunctional step 1 is missing); clean 5/5. With no loss as the criterion, clean_model is the only candidate. The 97-run proof covers PWML only, not SBML.

open_questions: Offline (no PathBank DB) the strict quarantine drops reactions whose participants carry no external id, so an offline generate() of a view can show fewer reactions than the stored run once had with the DB. The web server's generate must run with the DB resolution it has in production, or the product owner must accept this. Not a bug in generate.

For the web lane (V10), F7: generate() swaps process-wide environment variables (blank PATHBANK_DB_*, T2PW_OFFLINE_CURATOR=1) for the length of a PWML export and of the quarantine step, and restores them afterwards. That swap must not leak into job subprocesses (a subprocess started during an export inherits blank DB variables) and is not thread-safe; V10 must serialise generate() calls or run it in its own process. Not fixed here.

Arm (a) uses a baseline replay without the final-payload fill step. A replay with the fill (--flag 1, live public lookups via the fill cache) is a different input (a filled payload) and is not compared; generate does not fill, the web server fills upstream when it builds the big payload.

SBGN/KGML/SBML run quarantine_and_close once more per (view, controls) besides the PWML export (memoised, about one extra pass); an export-side hook returning the kept payload would avoid it but needs a change under pwml/service, which this track must not make.

F1(b), for V7/V10: PWML carries canonical names (after the pre-freeze canonicalizers and DB resolution) while SBML, KGML and SBGN built from the quarantine-kept payload carry the stored names; the same entity can be spelled differently across formats.

F2, for V7/V10: the quarantine decision and the PWML export must see the same DB availability. generate() blanks the DB variables for both steps; a server that resolves against a DB must do so for both together, or the kept graph and the PWML can differ.
